description: Seamless top-down material textures for the match viewer's map renderer. Presentation only: walls, cover and sightlines always come from the map's tile data. The renderer adds its own lighting, shadows and ambient occlusion, so textures are lit flat.
style: Seamless tileable texture, perfectly orthographic top-down view looking straight down, photorealistic material detail at a scale where one image covers about 4 by 4 metres, flat even diffuse lighting with no cast shadows, no vignette, no perspective, edges tile seamlessly on all four sides. For a premium tactical shooter esports game's overhead map. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people or watermarks.
